name: Demo: text tools (Python)
objective: Build a tiny pure-Python package `texttools` with three functions: slugify(text) -> str (lowercase, ASCII, words joined by '-'), word_count(text) -> int, and is_palindrome(text) -> bool (ignoring case, spaces and punctuation). Every function has unit tests.
rules: Python 3 standard library only; no third-party packages.
Package code lives in texttools/ (with __init__.py); tests live in tests/ as test_*.py files using unittest.
Do not claim tests passed: the platform runs them.
acceptance_criteria: Each function has at least two unit tests, including an edge case.
